test_cases.name: low_income_promise_copy
test_cases.input: Write a landing page headline and short intro for a budget grocery savings app targeting low-income families.
assertions: Produces both English and Arabic versions
Applies at least one open loop or cliffhanger

test_cases.name: middle_income_asset_copy
test_cases.input: Create marketing copy for a productivity tool aimed at middle-income professionals who want better ROI on their time.
assertions: Frames the offer as an asset / investment with ROI

test_cases.name: high_income_philosophy_copy
test_cases.input: Develop brand messaging for a luxury advisory service targeting high-income clients who care about identity and legacy.
assertions: Avoids pure ROI or feature focus
Produces dual-language content with matching emotional weight
